correctness.rationale: For n≥2, height≤3 Dyck paths have intermediate binary v_t=(h_t−t mod2)/2, with alternate even-time complement giving an affine bijection to no-consecutive-ones strings y_2..y_{2n−2} of length m=2n−3. This preserves Walsh magnitudes with eight ambient-character copies. Signed Fibonacci independence sums obey z_j=z_{j−1}+ε_jz_{j−2}; all-negative signs give period6 sequence and zeros exactly n≡2 mod3, with sign switch achieving sharp gap2 there and gap1 elsewhere by path-count parity. Independent complete integer Walsh–Hadamard spectra n≤8 give path count n8=610, zero count7032, rank58504 and exactly ten weight-three zeros (none of smaller weight), matching frozen certificate list. This does NOT assert any all-length low-degree threshold beyond n8.
